items.title: 67750_Sippie Wallace oral history interview
items.q: I never, I never, I never knew nobody by that name.

ctx.x: I know where I can play every key. Any key you can sing, I can change it around so I knows how to play every song in any key. Any song, if you can't sing in one key, I'll put it in your key. You know, so many people don't know what key you sing in. You can sing a song (unintelligible) but you don't know what key you're singing, you know. But I know my key. And (inaudible) teached me, always know your key. Know your key. Then you can tell, play me a song in G. Play me something in C, or play me a song in C, you…

Ms. Wallace, in November 1926, around -- in 1926, I see that they say here that there was a Cicero Thomas who played the coronet. And somebody else wrote underneath it that you never knew somebody by that name.
